Holds up. Fun run and gun without much to think about. Plays beautifully on the Deck.

Very fun, very nice game.

My only critique is the with the final enemies and the final boss:
  The final enemies don't let you run and slaughter them, you need to take cover, which ain't nice.
  The final boss battle is just a bunch of regular enemies and quick-time events, no direct combat with the boss itself.

Other than that, Space Marine is a very fun game, I recommend it very much.

Arguably the best 40k game of all time (besides maybe Dawn of War)
Positives:
+ Fun & badass gameplay that feels like a mix of gear of war and a hack n slash
+ The story is simple and servicable, but great if you love the 40k universe (Captain Titus is the best ultramarine)
+ The weapons are all satisfying to use and the enemies are really fun to fight against 
+ campaign is varied and fun but also knows when to end and doesn't overstay it's welcome
+ Horde mode is a load of fun with buddies
+ The music is so epic and triumphant 
+ Multiplayer is pretty fun (if a bit challenging) and most of the cosmetics and weapons you earn in-game instead of through battle passes, micro transactions, and other bs (though the few dlc skins they do have are pretty solid dlc)
+ The character customization for multiplayer is insanely good (arguably as good as Halo Reach during the same time and even better than Halo Infinite which came out a decade later)

Negatives:
- The game is old so finding a match might be time consuming (but not impossible) and there might be a chance you'll run into cheaters.
- The few boss fights are disappointing (especially the final boss that's just a glorified Quick-Time-Event)
- This game is a must play and an underrated gem IMO, but I will admit the fact they relaunched this game in a anniversary package just to bump the price high up is scummy. Would definitely be more mad if it was for a lesser game that couldn't still get you your money's worth.
